title: Salerno Cultura — Portanova and Piazza Flavio Gioia

facts.fact: PiazzaFlavioGioia is also calledRotonda because of the curved surrounding building fronts.
facts.excerpt: piazza Flavio Gioia, detta la Rotonda per la forma arcuata dei palazzi

facts.fact: Portanova and FlavioGioia are separate spaces linked by a gate rebuilt1754.
